# Ezekiel 25 — Disagreement Log

## 25:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | The LORD gave me this message: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 25:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-say to-the-sons-of Ammon, 'Hear the-word-of the-Lord YHWH: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Because you-said "Aha!" against My-sanctuary when-it-was-profaned, and-against the-land-of Israel when-it-was-desolated, and-against the-house-of Judah when-they-went into-exile —' |
| LOGOS | Say to the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD: Thus says the Lord GOD: Because you said, 'Aha!' over My sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was desolated, and over the house of Judah when they went into exile, |
| PNEUMA | Say to the Ammonites: Listen to this message from the Sovereign LORD! You cheered when my Temple was destroyed. You laughed at Israel's devastation and mocked Judah's exile. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

| LOGOS | Thus says the Lord GOD: Because Edom acted revengefully against the house of Judah and has grievously offended in taking vengeance on them, |
| PNEUMA | This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Edom has sinned terribly by taking revenge against the people of Judah. |
